# Long-context coherence: state versus evidence availability

Two fictional 80-turn histories, four probes, full versus recent8, 16 actual Qwen2.5 1.5B local calls. Strict global correctness 6/8 vs 3/8; post-hoc semantic scoring 8/8 vs 4/8; evidence-aware 8/8 vs 7/8. Recent visible 4/4 correct, hidden 3/4 appropriately unknown. Reported prompt tokens 3774 vs 1358. Not native Persimmon, not free-running dialogue or human validation. Two correlated scenarios only; no training or human efficacy claim.
